gbm_population_evidence.quote: Patients with glioblastoma, IDH-wildtype (as defined by WHO 2021 Classification of CNS Tumors) that has recurred following prior radiotherapy.

candidate_evidence.quote: autologous T cells transduced with a bicistronic lentiviral vector containing a murine scFv targeting EGFR and a humanized scFv targeting IL13Ra2

role_evidence.quote: autologous T cells transduced with a bicistronic lentiviral vector containing a murine scFv targeting EGFR and a humanized scFv targeting IL13Ra2

agents.drug_class_hint: autologous dual-targeting CAR-T cell therapy (EGFR epitope 806 and IL13Ra2), intrathecal

source_quote.quote: Tumor tissue positive for wild-type EGFR amplification by NeoGenomics Laboratories.
Patients with glioblastoma, IDH-wildtype (as defined by WHO 2021 Classification of CNS Tumors)

coder_notes: CAR-T cell therapy is an excluded intervention type, so there is no candidate. EGFR amplification is mechanistically linked to the CAR-T (EGFR epitope 806) but candidate_matched is false because that agent is not a candidate. MGMT promoter methylation only changes the required interval since radiotherapy and is not an entry requirement, so not listed.
